copy.title: Left Right Christmas Game Printable: 6 Pass the Gift Stories for Family, Office and Kids, Big-Type Host Cards and TV Screen Version
copy.description:
A left right Christmas game for your family Christmas party, office party or classroom: 6 original pass-the-gift stories, each with its own big-type host card AND a TV screen version, plus a story you can fill with your own guests' names. A fun game for a large group, with no prep: read, pass, laugh, keep the gift.

How it works: everyone holds a wrapped gift. The host reads a story out loud. Every time you hear LEFT, pass your gift left; every time you hear RIGHT, pass it right. Whoever holds a gift when the story ends keeps it. Each story takes about 2 to 3 minutes.

THE 6 STORIES (all original, no movie or song characters)
1. The Family Christmas Countdown: family (16 passes)
2. The Office Party Memo: office and adults (16 passes)
3. The Snowman's Missing Mitten: kids and classrooms (16 passes)
4. The Road to Bethlehem: church, family and sunday school (18 passes)
5. The Gift Nobody Wanted: white elephant and gift swaps (14 passes)
6. The Last-Minute Shopper: quick game, any group (15 passes)
Story 5 adds a white elephant STEAL twist: on STEAL, swap gifts with the player across from you.

3 WAYS TO PLAY
- Paper: print the big-type host cards (15 to 18 pt type, easy to read in a dim room)
- TV: open the PDF on a laptop or tablet connected to your TV; 6 widescreen story slides so everyone reads along
- Type-in names: type 6 guests' names into the family story in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader, then print or show it

WHAT'S INCLUDED (16 pages + a thank-you page)
- Page 1: Cover with the story list
- Page 2: How to Play, with the rules, 3 twists and host tips
- Page 3: Host Guide: which story suits which crowd, time and number of passes
- Pages 4 to 9: 6 big-type host cards, one story per page
- Page 10: Type-in names story (6 fill-in boxes, or print blank and write names in)
- Pages 11 to 16: TV screen version, one 16:9 slide per story

HOW TO GET IT
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing will be shipped. After purchase, download the PDF from your Etsy account (You > Purchases) or from the email Etsy sends. The printable pages are US Letter; they print on A4 with "Fit to page". Prints in color, or in black and white on any home printer.

For personal use at your own events. Please do not resell or share the file.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
